analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Emerging from a double bottom base with neckline resistance at 982.83. The stock trades above its rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, backed by an RSI of 63. However, overhead supply remains pronounced, requiring high-volume expansion to validate a sustainable pivot clearance.
63MOONS.fundamental: Consolidated fundamentals remain challenged by recurring quarterly losses, negative ROE (-1.98%), and negative ROCE (-3.70%). Although the company operates debt-free with proprietary ODIN trading software assets, erratic operational margins and unpredictable bottom-line swings fail CANSLIM institutional quality thresholds.
63MOONS.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below the 886.75 base support. Strictly cut losses if pivot resistance at 982.83 rejects breakout attempts.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Approaching 20-session pivot resistance at 114.91 on 1.66x volume. Price sits above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI 61. However, historical volatility and lack of institutional sponsorship weaken the setup's breakout sustainability.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Micro-cap bulk drug distributor showing deteriorating operational metrics with sales plunging 56.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.4% in Q1 FY27. Razor-thin operating margins (2.8%) and weak ROE (3.1%) completely fail CANSLIM fundamental screening standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breakdown below the 104.57 stop level invalidates the swing low structure; enforce immediate loss-cutting discipline if price retreats.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructive double bottom consolidation with price pressing 20-session pivot at 513.51. Price holds above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, complemented by positive MACD and RSI momentum confirming orderly Stage 2 accumulation.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Operating turnaround driven by API price recovery and commercial production at Sayakha. Q2 FY27 PAT jumped 83.3% YoY to ₹82.8 Cr with revenue rising 26.6% YoY. Manageable debt-to-equity (0.45x) and expanding operating leverage support fundamental resurgence.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Break below 455.37 stop breaches base support and invalidates the reversal thesis. Cut losses immediately without hesitation.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout to all-time highs above 1003.4 on 2.96x volume expansion. The stock exhibits pristine Stage 2 trend alignment above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, reflecting powerful institutional accumulation and superior relative strength.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Stellar performance fueled by CDMO traction and API exports. Q2 FY27 net profit surged 155.8% YoY with revenue up 45.9% and operating margins reaching 26%. Low net debt (0.37x D/E) and ROCE expansion fulfill O'Neil's institutional leadership criteria.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Thesis invalidates if price slips below the 907.75 pivot floor; cut losses promptly to protect trading capital.

AARVI.technical: Consolidating near 20-session pivot at 161.16 above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD resides above the signal and zero line with two aligned swing lows, though volume remains subdued ahead of the breakout.
AARVI.fundamental: Engineering staffing provider reports steady Q1 FY27 revenue growth (+14.1% YoY) and net profit expansion (+41.9% YoY). While balance sheet is virtually debt-free with 13% ROE, slim margins (~3%) and decelerating quarterly profit growth warrant caution.
AARVI.risk: Breach of 146.04 stop level dismantles the higher-low base structure; exit trade immediately upon violation.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Decisive SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance at 416.87 on massive 2.87x volume. Moving averages show classic Stage 2 stack (EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200) with bullish MACD momentum confirming institutional leadership.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Financial services giant demonstrating steady ~32% YoY revenue growth and 31.9% EPS growth in Q2 FY27. Strong lending book expansion across NBFC and housing finance verticals, paired with a 31.2% 3-year ROE, provides top-tier institutional sponsorship.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Violation of 390.48 pivot stop negates breakout momentum; enforce rigid Minervini risk discipline.
